properties.description: At step 2 of flow:release-cut, beside the changelog's opening paragraph, the cut writes two short statements for the release: what it adds to the --call setup (and the read/write verbs), and which of its changes still need a hosted gateway such as flo2.io. Each statement is checked through --call on the release's own binary before it is written, never inferred from the code. A release with nothing for either side says so in a line. First applied by hand to v0.83.2 on 2026-10-12, after its tag: --call gains reply budgets on every bounded tool and compare_designs paging over base_path/other_path; the hub view (merged search, fan-out, cross-design reads by graph_id) still needs flo2.io's gateway, because --call and the read verb refuse --remote (dec:idea-a-one-shot-call-reaches-the-design-where-it-is-served is the open question). Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019Xbw6PG9mXJiU2Sb421fnq
